T: Walk, don't run, to the buffet.
D: A young woman in Detroit is followed by something that only ever walks towards her.
P: Serve the snacks when the gang heads to the public pool for the last stand.
S: a nod to the film's Detroit setting
Cocktail franks simmered 5 minutes, tucked into split mini rolls, topped with a spoon of beef chilli simmered with cumin and paprika, a stripe of yellow mustard and finely diced raw onion.
Jay floating in her above-ground pool in the opening
Brown onions cooked slowly in butter for 40 minutes until jammy, cooled, folded through sour cream and cream cheese with salt, pepper and chives, served with thick ridged potato chips.
Yara reading out loud from her shell-shaped e-reader
Lavash cut into squares, folded in half over a ball of foil, brushed with oil and sesame, baked at 180C for 8 minutes until set open like a shell. Filled with whipped feta.
M: Detroit's own hot dog, made the long way
Fine beef mince simmered 45 minutes with onion, chilli powder, cumin, paprika and a little beef stock until loose and saucy, spooned over griddled franks in steamed buns, raw onion and mustard.
driving the Detroit suburbs all night
Pork marinated with garlic, oregano and lemon, griddled and sliced, wrapped in warm pita with tzatziki, tomato, onion and chips.
W: a slow summer with nowhere to go
Soft chocolate cookies baked at 175C for 9 minutes, cooled, sandwiched with a thick slice of vanilla ice cream, rolled in mini choc chips and frozen an hour before serving.
K: Lemon juice, sugar syrup and cold water in a big jug, sliced lemon and plenty of ice.

s.note: a nod to the film's Detroit setting
s.how: Brown 250g beef mince with half a diced onion, 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp paprika, add 150ml water and simmer 20 minutes. Simmer 16 cocktail franks for 5 minutes. Tuck into split mini rolls, spoon over chilli, add mustard and diced onion.

s.note: Jay floating in her above-ground pool in the opening
s.how: Cook 2 sliced onions in 30g butter over low heat for 40 minutes until jammy, then cool and chop. Fold into 200g sour cream and 100g cream cheese with salt, pepper and chives. Serve with a big bag of ridged potato chips.

m.note: driving the Detroit suburbs all night
m.how: Marinate 700g pork shoulder steaks in 3 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp oregano, juice of 1 lemon and 3 tbsp olive oil for 2 hours. Griddle 4 minutes a side and slice thin. Mix 250g Greek yoghurt with half a grated cucumber and garlic for tzatziki. Wrap the pork in 4 warm pitas with tzatziki, sliced tomato and red onion.

w.note: a slow summer with nowhere to go
w.how: Beat 100g butter and 150g brown sugar with 1 egg, then mix in 150g flour and 30g cocoa. Scoop 8 cookies and bake at 175C for 9 minutes. Cool, sandwich with thick slices of vanilla ice cream, roll the edges in mini choc chips and freeze an hour.

d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Mix with the juice of 5 lemons and 1L cold water in a big jug. Add sliced lemon and plenty of ice and pour into four glasses.
